avoid_supplements.name: Potassium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Cephalexin may cause hyperkalemia; combined supplementation increases risk of dangerous potassium elevation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid potassium supplements unless specifically prescribed by physician; monitor serum potassium levels

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics (Lactobacillus, Saccharomyces boulardii)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Antibiotic may reduce beneficial bacterial flora; probiotics may help restore microbiome balance
caution_supplements.action: May take probiotics during and after treatment; separate administration by 2+ hours if possible

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Cephalexin may form complexes with divalent cations reducing absorption of both agents
caution_supplements.action: Separate administration by 2-3 hours; monitor for adequate absorption of both products

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (taken immediately before/with cephalexin)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Fat delays gastric emptying and may reduce cephalexin absorption rate, potentially decreasing peak serum levels
avoid_foods.action: Take cephalexin 1 hour before or 2 hours after high-fat meals for optimal absorption

caution_foods.name: Dairy products (milk, yogurt, cheese)
caution_foods.mechanism: Calcium and magnesium in dairy may form chelation complexes with cephalexin, modestly reducing absorption
caution_foods.action: Separate dairy consumption by 2+ hours from cephalexin dosing when possible

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Alcohol may increase GI upset and theoretically increase risk of disulfiram-like reaction (rare with cephalosporins)
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol consumption during treatment; counsel patient on potential GI side effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor for allergic reactions especially in patients with penicillin allergy (cross-reactivity ~1-3%). Assess renal function as cephalexin is renally eliminated; adjust dosing in severe renal impairment (CrCl <30 mL/min). Monitor for C. difficile-associated diarrhea with prolonged use.
